script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let ability be the id of the move labelled "absorb_magic_attack" on arg.
Arg uses ability with its cast time and then [{abilityTag: "absorb_magic_attack_animation"}, {abilityTag: "absorb_magic_attack", abilityOptions: call game:ai.AiUtil.makeAbilityOptionsForSubEffect, conditions: {targetType: game:Conf.ENEMY_BUILTIN_MULTIPLE_TARGET_TYPE.SAME_CAN_HIT}}].

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let ability be executer → without-and-lot-ability.
Depending on ability
  Case the id of the move labelled "absorb_magic_attack" on executer
    Call helper with (executer).
    Break.
  Case the id of the move labelled "absorb_attack" on executer
    Call helper2 with (executer).
    Break.
  Default
    Executer uses ability.
